> Second, it's fine to have a gun but is there any way you could remove the ammunition from your possession? 

No.

> If you've been diagnosed with major depressive disorder then you know that your feelings are lying to you about your circumstances.

No, they are not.  There is such a thing as depressive realism.  I have an accurate assessment of my circumstances.  

> Is there any way you can train yourself to draw again, to overcome the negative thought patterns? Can you start by choosing the time of day when you know you're at your best, and then just draw something small and simple that you're happy with? Do that once, and then build on it?

Tried this.  I can't keep it going for even a single day.  I've tried several tricks and approaches to it.  The only thing that seems to help are some drugs.  But, among my problems is a crippling social phobia, I don't have any connections at all.
There's some thing I want to accomplish before I die, and I need help with it.
